abi.entrypoint: vLLM offline LLM API with an equivalent online serving route

computation.definition: Run the frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B AutoRound GPTQ W4A16 group-128 text checkpoint autoregressively through vLLM. Given one or more tokenized natural-language prompts, execute all 24 transformer layers, recurrent and KV state updates, the tied output projection, and greedy token selection for 64 output tokens per request.
dependencies: each generated token depends on the complete recurrent and KV state from all preceding tokens
the 18 linear-attention layers each execute fused QKVZ and output projections; six full-attention layers each execute fused QKV and output projections
all 24 layers execute fused MLP gate-up and down projections
projection replacement must preserve the frozen GPTQ integer weights, group-128 scales, causal state updates and greedy token sequence
forbidden_rewrites: changing GPTQ integer weights, scales or group size
changing the output-head shortlist or sampling policy
speculative decoding, token pruning, skipped layers or early exit
using FP16 activations in place of the frozen BF16 activation contract
legal_rewrites: lossless repacking of the frozen GPTQ tensors
kernel and epilogue fusion that preserves mathematical dependencies
CUDA Graph-compatible runtime routing by active batch

inputs.layout: one contiguous token-ID row per request
inputs.name: input_ids

numerics.acceptance: Every frozen natural workload case must produce exactly the same 64 token IDs as stock GPTQ-Marlin. Candidate weights and scales must retain their source bit patterns; a broader paired task-quality gate is required before any relaxation of token identity.
numerics.reference: Unmodified vLLM 0.28.1 GPTQ-Marlin execution of the SHA-256-bound Qwen3.5-0.8B W4A16 group-128 checkpoint with BF16 activations and greedy decoding.
